title: How many factors of 2?
text: $$2^{5}$$ means $$2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2$$, five factors. A common mistake is to compute $$2 \times 5 = 10$$. What is $$2 \times 2$$, the product of the first two factors?

title: Keep multiplying
text: $$4 \times 2 = 8$$, $$8 \times 2 = 16$$, and one more factor of 2 remains. What is $$16 \times 2$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$2^{5} = 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 32$$. Common mistake: answering 10. General rule: the exponent counts factors of the base. It does not tell you to multiply the base by the exponent.
